## 📊 Rapport hebdo & coaching IA
Chaque lundi à 8h (ou `/rapport`) :
- statistiques de la semaine (offres, candidatures, entretiens, taux de réponse)
- **compétences les plus demandées** qui te manquent (agrégées sur 30 jours)
- un **coach IA** analyse tes chiffres et te donne 3 actions concrètes + la compétence à travailler cette semaine

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE collected_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS collected,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE scored_at   > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS analysed,
  (SELECT round(avg(score)) FROM jobs WHERE scored_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS avg_score,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE scored_at > now() - interval '7 days'
      AND score >= (SELECT alert_threshold FROM profile WHERE id = 1))::int AS top_matches,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kind = 'cover_letter' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS letters,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM status_history WHERE to_status = 'applied'   AND changed_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS applied,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM status_history WHERE to_status = 'interview' AND changed_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS interviews,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM status_history WHERE to_status = 'offer'     AND changed_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS offers,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM status_history WHERE to_status = 'rejected'  AND changed_at > now() - interval '7 days')::int AS rejections,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM applications)::int AS total_applications,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j JOIN applications a ON a.job_id = j.id WHERE j.status IN ('interview','offer','rejected'))::int AS total_answers,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(status, total), '{}') FROM v_pipeline) AS pipeline,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (SELECT skill, occurrences FROM v_missing_skills LIMIT 8) t) AS missing_skills,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, title, company, score FROM jobs
     WHERE status IN ('new','shortlisted') AND score IS NOT NULL AND collected_at > now() - interval '7 days'
     ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5) t) AS best_open,
  (SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM (SELECT headline, target_roles, skills, years_experience FROM profile WHERE id = 1) p) AS profile;
INSERT INTO documents (kind, content) VALUES ('weekly_report', $1) RETURNING id;
